# Ronaldo is the highest paid athlete in the world
Ronaldo is the highest paid athlete in the world
Real Madrid and Portugal superstar Cristiano Ronaldo is the highest paid athlete in the world according to Forbes
Real Madrid and Portugal superstar Cristiano Ronaldo is the highest paid athlete in the world according to Forbes.
Ronaldo earned US $93 million last year which included $58 million US in salaries and winnings and $38 million endorsements.
Basketball superstar LeBron James who is currently playing in the NBA finals series for the Cavaliers against the Golden State Warriors, came in second with $86.2 million US.
Barcelona’s Lionel Messi came in third with a earning of $80 million US for the past 12 months.

# World's highest paid athletes 2026
Published by Statista Research Department , Jun 8, 2026
The highest paid athlete in the world as of May 2026 was Cristiano Ronaldo. The Al-Nassr soccer star took home total earnings of 300 million U.S. dollars, of which an estimated 65 million U.S. dollars were off-field earnings through endorsements.

## Messi vs. Ronaldo continues
Despite the ongoing debate among fans and in the media about who is the better soccer player between Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi , it is the former that led the way in terms of total earnings in 2025/26.
As well as winning an incredible amount of trophies , Ronaldo is winning off the pitch, too, thanks to a lucrative sponsorship deal with Nike , and endorsements with DAZN, Electronic Arts, and Tag Heuer.
Meanwhile, eight-time Ballon d'Or winner Messi had an equal share of on- and -off field earnings, which totaled 140 million U.S. dollars.
